claims.claim: One-time expenses related to the Nagarro acquisition impacted the reported PAT margin and EPS by approximately 3.1% for the quarter.
claims.quote: For Q2 FY27, these expenses impacted the reported PAT margin as well as the reported EPS by around 3.1%.

claims.claim: The company witnessed a slowdown in decision-making in the last few weeks of the quarter.
claims.quote: The slowdown of decision making in the last few weeks was pretty apparent.

claims.claim: The company expects to incur an incremental USD 25 to 30 million in transaction costs over the next two quarters.
claims.quote: Over the next two quarters, we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million to be incurred towards the Nagarro transaction.

claims.claim: The company has secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital.
claims.quote: We have secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital excluding treasury shares at the expiry of the additional acceptance period

claims.claim: The combined entity would be the 2nd largest digital engineering player globally.
claims.quote: We would, as a combination, look to be the 2nd largest digital engineering player globally

claims.claim: The combined entity will not have significantly lower margins than Persistent's current margins.
claims.quote: we do not believe that the combined entity will be at any significant lower margins than what Persistent has today.

claims.claim: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS and Reported EPS accretive in Year 1.
claims.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses

claims.claim: We are confident with our progress in AI, with the investments that we are doing, we'll continue to gain market share.
claims.quote: we are confident with our progress in AI, with the investments that we are doing, we'll continue to gain market share.

claims.claim: The demand that we are seeing from tech companies in terms of AI-led software development lifecycle is the highest.
claims.quote: The demand that we are seeing from them in terms of AI-led software development lifecycle is the highest.

claims.claim: Using AI technology should be margin neutral or accretive because we should be able to do more work with lesser people.
claims.quote: And most of these things should be margin neutral or accretive because if we use technology, we should be able to do more work with lesser people and more technology.

claims.claim: New Labor Codes caused a 2.3% impact on EBIT margin and 1.8% on PAT margin.
claims.quote: New Labor Codes were recently announced in India, which required additional provisioning for gratuity payment and leave encashment, leading to an impact of ~2.3% on the EBIT margin

claims.claim: AI platform and tool-driven pricing models contributed to a 150 basis point improvement in margins.
claims.quote: Couple of engagements of this nature, which we signed in the last quarter and which are now scaling up, have contributed to an improvement in margin by 150 basis points.

claims.claim: Top 100 customers grew by 20.1% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Top 100 customers by 20.1%.

claims.claim: Excluding the one-time labor code impact, EBIT margin would have been 16.7%, a 40 basis point improvement over Q2 FY26.
claims.quote: Excluding the one-time impact of labour code, our EBIT margin would have been 16.7%, a 40 basis point improvement over Q2 FY26.

claims.claim: EBIT margin reached 16.3%, translating to 230 basis points improvement over the prior year's same quarter.
claims.quote: Our EBIT margin reached 16.3%, driving 12.7% QoQ and 43.7% YoY growth in absolute terms. This translates into 230 basis points improvement over the prior year's same quarter.

claims.claim: The pipeline is good and broad-based, reflecting in our order wins.
claims.quote: The pipeline is good. The pipeline, I would say it's broad-based and that is reflecting in our order wins.

claims.claim: Up to 80 to 100 basis points of the wage hike impact is expected to get offset through margin levers.
claims.quote: up to 80 to 100 basis points of this impact is expected to get offset through a combination of other margin levers

claims.claim: The company expects EBIT margins to improve over the medium term.
claims.quote: we are pretty much confident that from a going forward basis we are pretty much on the track as far as the margin trajectory is concerned.

claims.claim: The company expects all three verticals (BFSI, Hi-Tech, Healthcare) to grow during the year.
claims.quote: I'm reasonably confident all the three verticals will grow and we have said publicly in our last earnings calls as well.

claims.claim: The company delayed annual wage hikes by one quarter due to business uncertainty.
claims.quote: In view of the current uncertain business scenario, we have decided to postpone our wage hike by a quarter.
